titles.sum: A new Tubi Original boxing thriller, and the free service's biggest premiere of the weekend. Watch on any device with no account required.
John Woo's nearly wordless revenge thriller. A father loses his voice and his son to gang violence on Christmas Eve, then spends a year training to settle the score.
The long-running reality series following couples who met while one partner was incarcerated, as they try to make it work on the outside.
The full series is streaming free with ads. A good catch-up before the prequel Sunrise on the Reaping hits theaters Nov 20. (Peacock also adds them Nov 14 for subscribers.)

titles.t: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
titles.sum: King Arthur and his knights hunt for the Grail on a budget so small they use coconuts for horses. Still one of the most quoted comedies ever made.
Patrick Wilson directs and stars as the Lambert family is pulled back into the spirit realm ten years after the first films.
A woman revisits a holiday she took with her young father in the '90s. Quiet, devastating, and one of the best-reviewed films of its year. Also on Pluto TV.
Stephen Chow's cartoon-style martial arts comedy about a wannabe gangster and a run-down tenement full of hidden kung fu masters.
Ben Stiller meets Robert De Niro's suspicious ex-CIA father-in-law. Timely: the fourth film opens in theaters Nov 25.
Pluto has added a run of the Tom Cruise spy series, from the 1996 original through Dead Reckoning. Free, no sign-up.
The washed-up cast of a cancelled space TV show gets recruited by real aliens who think the show was a documentary.
The original paranormal exterminators and their slime-filled sequel. Easy family movie night.
Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye stage a show to save their old general's Vermont inn. Leads Pluto's holiday lineup.
Arnold Schwarzenegger battles every other parent in town for the year's must-have toy on Christmas Eve.
Santa's clumsy younger son races to deliver one forgotten present before sunrise. A modern animated holiday favorite.
Tom Hanks drifts through three decades of American history. Best Picture winner, free with ads.
Jigsaw travels to Mexico for an experimental cancer cure and turns his traps on the scammers who sold it to him.
The early-2000s Nickelodeon sitcom about a Mexican-American family in San Antonio arrives with its movie, Mysteries of the Maya, and the revival The Garcias.
A 1973 expedition to an uncharted island meets the giant ape who rules it.
Tubi Original. A quiet suburban woman hides dark secrets, and the handymen she invites into her home keep disappearing.
The final chapter of Tubi's hit teen romance franchise starring Noah Beck and Siena Agudong.
Tubi Original true-crime thriller about South Carolina serial killer Pee Wee Gaskins.

Jessica Chastain plays a semi-retired country star who returns to Nashville when her niece, a rising singer, disappears. Directed by Shana Feste, with Garrett Hedlund, Ross Lynch and Jennifer Nettles.
Philomena Cunk, the cheerfully clueless documentary host, takes on the history of film.
The German period drama about Empress Elisabeth of Austria returns for a third season.
Two modern horror hits land on Netflix: Smile (R) and the original Insidious (PG-13).

titles.t: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
titles.sum: The MomTok reality franchise heads to Southern California with a new cast of influencer moms.
Paddington and the Browns travel to Peru to find his Aunt Lucy, who has gone missing from her retirement home. The safest pick for kids this weekend.
A recovering comedian and the dentist fixing his broken tooth spend a strange Christmas Eve together in Baltimore.
Dakota Johnson plays a New York paramedic who starts seeing the future, from Sony's Spider-Man side universe.

titles.t: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal
titles.sum: A docuseries on the controversy behind the Miss Universe pageant.
The crowd-funded life-of-Jesus drama returns with its sixth season.
Kelsey Grammer's revival, with Frasier back in Boston near his firefighter son.
Rose Byrne and Meghann Fahy star in this limited series from Karin Slaughter's bestseller, about two sisters scarred by a violent attack in their childhood. All episodes drop at once.
Anthony Mackie plays a disgraced FBI agent chasing Jamie Dornan's career criminal across Europe after a raid on a Zurich bank vault. Two episodes Friday, then one a week through Christmas.
From CODA director Siân Heder: the true story of the 1977 sit-in that occupied a San Francisco federal building for disability rights. Ruth Madeley stars with Mark Ruffalo.
Shemar Moore's Hondo leads a unit of green recruits. This week the team handles a middle school lockdown.
The BAFTA-winning police drama about rookie officers in Belfast returns for a fourth season.
All five films arrive for Peacock subscribers. They're already free on Tubi with ads, if you'd rather not pay.
The pups go prehistoric in a new feature for the preschool set.
Nickelodeon's slime-heavy awards show streams on Paramount+.
Holiday special episode from The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder.
Walter Salles' Oscar-winning Brazilian drama about a mother holding her family together after her husband disappears under the military dictatorship.
A Starz-exclusive crime drama directed by Berner and Alex Ferrufino.
David O. Russell's film about football coach and broadcaster John Madden, with Nicolas Cage in the title role.
A biopic of a young Anthony Bourdain, before the fame, filmed in Massachusetts. Arrives on streaming after its summer theatrical run.

titles.t: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Season 3
titles.sum: The demigod adventure series adapts the third book in Rick Riordan's series.
Horror-comedy starring Zazie Beetz as a woman who takes a job in a New York high-rise run by a murderous cult.

titles.t: Outlander: Blood of My Blood, new episode
titles.sum: The Outlander prequel about Claire's and Jamie's parents returns after a week off, two episodes before its finale.
The fourth and final season of the survival thriller about a girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness.
Fede Álvarez's back-to-basics Alien film: young colonists scavenging a derelict space station meet the franchise's deadliest life form.
Bong Joon Ho's follow-up to Parasite. Robert Pattinson plays an 'expendable' worker on an ice-planet colony who gets reprinted every time he dies.
Amy Poehler leads a new comedy series set on an archaeological dig, with Jason Mantzoukas. All episodes at once.
A docuseries on the Massachusetts murder trials that became a national obsession.
Four-part docuseries on New Wave music from 1977 to 1987 and how it pushed alternative culture into the mainstream.
The long-awaited series continuation of the Blade Runner films, starring Michelle Yeoh.
Peter Berg's film about the 1944 football game played by Marines on Guadalcanal before the Battle of Okinawa.
Family film based on Jocko Willink's book about a bullied kid whose Navy SEAL uncle helps him get tougher over one summer.
The steamy Texas thriller with Brittany Snow and Malin Akerman returns.
The killer doll returns, this time upgraded to fight a new military-grade android.
Mario and friends head to space in the sequel to the 2023 animated hit.
Political thriller: a nuclear submarine officer uncovers secrets that may tie a defense secretary to a global threat.
A woman stuck in a Christmas time loop has to confess her feelings to her lifelong crush to break it.
Arnold Schwarzenegger plays Santa, who uses the naughty list to track down whoever stole his magic bag.
A six-part adaptation of Jane Austen's novel with Emma Corrin as Elizabeth Bennet and Jack Lowden as Mr. Darcy.
Ava DuVernay, director of 13TH, examines the 14th Amendment and who gets to belong in America.
A two-episode holiday special with the cast of CBS's Ghosts.
Limited drama series with Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen as the Ramseys, amid a flawed investigation and a media frenzy.
Cameron Diaz plays a single mom trying to keep one promise to her daughter during a day that keeps going wrong.
Animated drama about two teens in Southern California surf culture whose romance is upended by a sudden illness.
Korean drama with Song Hye-kyo and Gong Yoo about friends from humble beginnings chasing success in 1970s showbiz.
Brad Pitt plays a former special forces soldier stranded in the Alaskan wilderness with his dog after a plane crash. David Ayer directs; J.K. Simmons co-stars.
Jessica Chastain stars in Rob Savage's horror film about a young girl, Bela, and the sinister 'Other Mommy' who appears to her. Based on Josh Malerman's novel.
An apartment manager (Matilda Lutz) with a fear of spiders is stuck in a quarantined building that turns out to be overrun by venomous ones.
Guillermo del Toro's dark fairy tale set in 1944 Spain arrives on digital in a new 4K restoration.
Zach Cregger's (Weapons) reboot follows a medical courier caught in one terrifying night of chaos. The best-reviewed video game movie ever on Rotten Tomatoes.
Christopher Nolan's epic, with Matt Damon as Odysseus trying to get home after the Trojan War, plus Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway and Lupita Nyong'o. Some stores may sell it before offering rentals.

Ti West (X, Pearl) turns Dickens into a ghost story, with Johnny Depp as Scrooge and Ian McKellen, Daisy Ridley and Sam Claflin. Rated PG-13 for frightening material, so it's spookier than most versions.
The story behind Sylvester Stallone's fight to make Rocky, with Matt Dillon and AnnaSophia Robb. Opens in select cities Nov 13 and nationwide Nov 20.
A limited anniversary re-release, in 3D at some locations. An easy outing for younger kids.
Takashi Yamazaki's follow-up to Godzilla Minus One. The first R-rated Godzilla film, for bloody violence. Shot for IMAX.

titles.t: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
titles.sum: The prequel about a young Haymitch Abernathy's Hunger Games, with Elle Fanning, Ralph Fiennes and Jesse Plemons.
Limited anniversary screenings of the Best Picture winner with Russell Crowe as mathematician John Nash.
Disney's new animated feature about a girl who discovers her family's magical past, with Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones and Stephen Fry.
Robert De Niro and Ben Stiller return for a fourth Meet the Parents film, joined by Skyler Gisondo and Owen Wilson. Opens Thanksgiving Eve.
David Harbour's brawling Santa is back, now joined by Kristen Bell.
David Leitch's satirical heist movie about bank robbers who livestream their crimes, with Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz.
Idris Elba leads a sci-fi thriller from Lionsgate.
Humphrey Bogart's Sam Spade returns to the big screen for limited anniversary showings.

Godzilla Minus Zero.take: Critics say it goes bigger and more emotional than Minus One. A few found it less focused.

Paddington in Peru.take: A warm, gentle family adventure in a fresh setting. The main knock is a slightly overstuffed plot.

Silent Night.take: Mixed. The near-wordless action set pieces carry it, but the story is thin and slow in stretches.

Being Heumann.take: From its TIFF premiere: uplifting and well acted, with Ruth Madeley a standout. Informative without preaching.

Madame Web.take: Panned by critics for a predictable plot and uneven execution. Audiences were kinder.

Heart of the Beast.take: Certified Fresh. Critics call it a stirring tribute to man's best friend.

Other Mommy.take: Critics praise Chastain's eerie turn as a smothering parent, but most found the film itself weak.

Resident Evil.take: Lots of scares in a tight runtime, with Austin Abrams adding comic relief. A fast, fun take on the games.

The Odyssey.take: Grand scale and a strong ensemble, with a human emotional core underneath the myth.

Monty Python and the Holy Grail.take: A comedy landmark that still holds up.

Aftersun.take: One of the most acclaimed films of 2022.

Galaxy Quest.take: Beloved by critics and sci-fi fans alike.

The Hunger Games (all five films).take: Scores shown are for the first film.

The Hunger Games films.take: Scores shown are for the first film.

Kung Fu Hustle.take: Stephen Chow's cartoonish martial-arts comedy is a critics' and audience favorite.

Arthur Christmas.take: One of the best-reviewed modern animated holiday films.

Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol.take: No reviews yet; they usually arrive a day or two before opening. Early test screenings reportedly scored very high.

Heartland.take: No reviews yet. Netflix films often get reviewed on release day.

Don't Quit.take: No reviews yet. Tubi Originals are rarely reviewed by major critics.

Don't Quit.basis: Tubi Original; these rarely get reviewed, so this leans on your taste

Insidious: The Red Door.basis: Late horror sequels usually review below the originals

Mission: Impossible collection.basis: Most entries rank among the best-reviewed action films

Ghostbusters & Ghostbusters II.basis: The original is a comedy classic

Jingle All the Way.basis: A cult favorite that critics didn't love

Saw X.basis: Better received than most Saw sequels

Sidelined 3: End Game.basis: Finale of one of Tubi's most-watched franchises

Heartland.basis: Chastain is consistently well reviewed; Feste's Country Strong was not

Cunk on Cinema.basis: Earlier Cunk specials were critics' favorites

The Empress, Season 3.basis: Returning drama with an established audience

The Baltimorons.basis: Indie holiday comedy from Jay Duplass

The Chosen, Season 6.basis: Earlier seasons scored very high with viewers

The Good Daughter.basis: Strong cast and a bestselling source novel

12 12 12.basis: Star-led heist series; no reviews yet

A Proud Family Wizmas.basis: Holiday special from a well-liked series

I'm Still Here.basis: Oscar winner for Best International Feature

Madden.basis: Big names; David O. Russell's recent films have been hit and miss

Tony.basis: Biopic of a beloved food writer

Yellowjackets, Season 4.basis: Final season of an acclaimed series

Alien: Romulus.basis: A well-received return to the franchise's horror roots

Mickey 17.basis: Bong Joon Ho's follow-up to Parasite

Blade Runner 2099.basis: Big franchise, strong lead; no reviews yet

The Mosquito Bowl.basis: Based on Buzz Bissinger's acclaimed book

Way of the Warrior Kid.basis: Family film from a popular kids' book

The Hunting Wives, Season 2.basis: Season 1 was a streaming hit with mixed reviews

Trinity.basis: New Netflix thriller; no reviews yet

Pride and Prejudice.basis: Austen adaptations with strong casts usually land well

14TH.basis: From the director of the acclaimed 13TH

Ghostsmas.basis: Ghosts is one of CBS's best-reviewed comedies

Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol.basis: Ti West's X and Pearl were critical hits, and test screenings scored high

The Angry Birds Movie (10th anniversary).basis: A kids' favorite that critics were lukewarm on

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.basis: Francis Lawrence directed the best-reviewed films in the series

Focker-in-Law.basis: Later sequels in the series reviewed poorly

Violent Night 2.basis: The first film was a fun surprise

How to Rob a Bank.basis: From the director of Bullet Train and The Fall Guy

Crawlers.basis: Indie creature feature; no reviews yet
